newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bertelsmann sets up publishing unit in China.
newsitem.headline: Bertelsmann sets up publishing unit in China.

text.p: German media giant Bertelsmann said on Sunday it was taking a shareholding in a publishing joint venture in China, the first ever by a non-Chinese company.
Bertelsmann said it would have a 49 percent stake in the publishing house, with the Shanghai Scientific and Technical Publishers company taking the 51 percent majority stake.
The new company, to be based in Shanghai, will publish trade books from Chinese scientific and technical authors as well as international works.
A news publishing unit is also planned, whose first title is scheduled to be a car magazine.
